title: Below-profile prescribed groundwater-level to lower-face-head equivalence
legacy_relation: For SWBOTB=1 below the profile: hbot = gwlinp - z_bottom_node + 0.5*dz_bottom = gwlinp - z_bottom_face.
equivalence_hypothesis: When the mode-1 prescribed groundwater-level elevation is below the profile and H_interface is identified with that same hydraulic elevation for this slice, both mappings produce identical lower-face pressure head and therefore enter the same mode-5 residual/Jacobian branch.
gates: all prescribed levels are below the -3.0 m bottom face
legacy hbot and current datum hbot agree within 1e-12 cm at every fixed level
roundtrip hbot->hydraulic head returns the prescribed groundwater level within 1e-14 m
the source-bound residual/Jacobian branch identity is recorded: SWBOTB=5 OR (SWBOTB=1 AND fllowgwl)
nonclaims: does not qualify inside-profile mode-1 active-domain truncation
does not qualify above-profile groundwater-level behavior
does not establish current F-GC interface head as a phreatic state generally
does not modify or admit production mode 1
next_if_pass: Proceed to LOW01-B typed inside-profile state-machine/hydraulic-domain research and LOW01-C branch-boundary characterization.
